capability.title: Publish to LinkedIn
capability.summary: Channel adapter with asset registration, first-comment support and scheduling. Compensable: a post can be deleted, so this one declares a compensation capability and the orchestrator can roll it back if a sibling step fails hard.

body.author: ={{ $('Envelope In').first().json.payload.account_ref }}
body.content: ={{ $('Register Media').first().json.value?.image ? { media: { id: $('Register Media').first().json.value.image, altText: $('Enforce Channel Limits').first().json.alt_text } } : undefined }}

with.note: Links live in the first comment rather than the post body: LinkedIn suppresses reach on posts with outbound links. A channel-specific tactic that belongs in the adapter, not in the copywriter's prompt.
